tei:div.tei:p: Miriam Klimova’s prayer “Молитва про захист наших сердець від ненависті” תפילה לשמירה על ליבנו משנאה (בזמן המלחמה) (Prayer to Protect Our Hearts from Hatred in Wartime), in the context of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, was first shared in Hebrew and Ukrainian via her Facebook page. She adds: “בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁאֵין אֲנָשִׁים, הִשְׁתַּדֵּל לִהְיוֹת אִישׁ” – פרקי אבות. “Навіть там, де немає людей, постарайся бути людиною” – Піркей Авот” (Where there are no moral human beings, be one. – Mishnah Avot 2.6). Find also the teaching of Shmuel haQatan in Mishnah Avot 4:19 and that of Rebbi Yehoshua ben Levi and Rebbi Yehanan in Megillah 10b. For these teachings in the context of the Shirat haYam (Song of the Sea) find our resource on Shirat haYam.
I prepared the English translation from the Ukrainian text. –Aharon Varady
